from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperInfo(BaseModel):
    """Metadata for a single paper extracted from the collection, including its references to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers from the provided collection that this paper cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperInfo]
